title: Receive XRP
description: A short XRP Mobile walkthrough: open Receive, pick XRP, and share your deposit address or QR code. We cover the XRP Ledger network warning that catches people out, and the 1 XRP minimum that a brand new XRPL account needs before it exists on the ledger. XRP Mobile is a self custody wallet where you can buy, send, receive and swap XRP.
lede: Someone owes you XRP. Here is exactly where to tell them to send it, and the two things that go wrong if you get it wrong.

steps.caption: Tap Receive
steps.body: From the wallet home, tap Receive. Nothing here costs anything: an address is just where funds land.

steps.caption: Pick the asset
steps.body: Pick the asset you're expecting. XRP Mobile holds more than XRP, and every asset has its own deposit address, so choosing the right one matters.

steps.caption: One asset, one network
steps.body: Read the warning. This address takes XRP on the XRP Ledger and nothing else. Anything sent on another network is gone, and no one can get it back.

steps.caption: Your address and QR
steps.body: Here is your address, with a QR for anyone standing next to you. Copy it or share it, and always check the first and last characters against what the sender typed.

steps.caption: At least 1 XRP the first time
steps.body: One catch on a brand new account: the first deposit has to be at least 1 XRP. That is the reserve the XRP Ledger asks for to let your account exist.

shots.alt: At least 1 XRP the first time
